data.name: Spectral Report
data.detailed_description:
Attention: The images at the game page are from a very early development version

Spectral Report is a cooperative psychological horror game where you and your team are

investigative journalists exploring dangerous and abandoned locations to document

and prove the existence of ghosts.

Armed only with cameras and courage, you must collect photographic evidence, investigate

unexplained phenomena, and survive long enough to tell the story. But there's a problem:

your sanity is constantly declining, and the line between reality and hallucination

becomes increasingly blurred.

🎭 REALITY OR HALLUCINATION?

The game's core mechanic creates constant tension: you never know if that shadowy figure

in the hallway is a stress-induced hallucination or a real threat. Trust your team,

share information, and try to stay calm as your sanity depletes with every moment spent

in the dark.

📸 DOCUMENT AND PUBLISH

Your mission doesn't end when you escape. After exploration, you and your team must:

• Select the best photos captured

• Write the perfect headline

• Craft a convincing report

• Publish for the community to review

The better your report, the greater the reward. Sharp photos of paranormal events are

worth their weight in gold – if you survive to share them.

🤝 COOPERATION IS ESSENTIAL

• Voice communication to coordinate actions

• Shared sanity system - staying together helps restore sanity

• Limited resources that must be used strategically

• Every team member is crucial to the mission's success

🏚️ HOSTILE AND REALISTIC ENVIRONMENTS

Explore detailed and dangerous locations:

• Abandoned factories with unstable structures

• Decommissioned hospitals full of secrets

• Claustrophobic underground bunkers

• Forgotten mansions with dark histories

Each location presents unique challenges, random events, and both natural and

supernatural dangers.

data.short_description: Enter abandoned locations as Spectral Reporters to prove the existence of ghosts. But beware: sanity is fragile, and not everything you see is real. Cooperate with your team, investigate the place, take evidences, and finally prove that ghosts are real.
data.supported_languages:
English*, Portuguese - Brazil
*languages with full audio support

  • Processor: ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: gtx 970
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: any
  • VR Support: no
  • Additional Notes: no
